يستهديان (form X)
# يَسْتَهْدِيَانِ (yastahdiyāni) /jas.tah.di.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# يُسْتَهْدَيَانِ (yustahdayāni) /jus.tah.da.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
